```artifact
Feature: Doorstop Requirements Management

  Scenario: Store requirements in a permanent and secure manner
    Given a new requirement with ID "REQ-001" and content "This is a new requirement"
    When the requirement is stored in Doorstop
    Then the requirement is persisted in a secure manner
    And the file permissions for the stored requirement are 644

  Scenario: Handle change management of the requirements
    Given a requirement with ID "REQ-001" and content "This is a new requirement"
    When a change is made to the requirement
    Then the change is recorded in the change history
    And the change history includes the timestamp and developer ID

  Scenario: Associate requirements changes to existing developer identification
    Given a requirement with ID "REQ-001" and content "This is a new requirement"
    When a change is made to the requirement by developer "John Doe"
    Then the change is associated with the developer's ID

  Scenario: Be scalable to support thousands of requirements
    Given a load of 1000 requirements
    When the requirements are stored in Doorstop
    Then the system responds within 2 seconds
    And the memory usage is less than 1 GB

  Scenario: Provide a lightweight installation method
    Given a clean system
    When the Doorstop installation script is run
    Then the installation is successful
    And the system is configured to use the default installation method

  Scenario Outline: Handle invalid inputs
    Given a requirement with ID "REQ-001" and content ""
    When the requirement is stored in Doorstop
    Then an error is raised with message "Invalid requirement content"

    Examples:
      | requirement ID | content |
      | REQ-001        | ""     |
      | REQ-002        | "abc"  |
      | REQ-003        | ""     |

  Scenario Outline: Test scalability with realistic load
    Given a load of 1000 requirements
    When the requirements are stored in Doorstop
    Then the system responds within 2 seconds
    And the memory usage is less than 1 GB

    Examples:
      | load size |
      | 1000      |
      | 5000      |
      | 10000     |

  Scenario Outline: Validate installation method
    Given a clean system
    When the Doorstop installation script is run
    Then the installation is successful
    And the system is configured to use the default installation method

    Examples:
      | installation method |
      | default             |
      | custom              |
      | manual              |
```
